crime: Robbing a convenience store with a water gun

key_facts: weapon_type: The suspect used a green plastic water gun painted black.
stolen_goods: The suspect stole exactly $43 and a bag of sour gummies.
escape_route: The suspect ran away on a pink electric scooter.
hideout: The suspect hid behind the dumpsters at the bowling alley next door.
motive_snacks: The suspect was just really hungry for candy.
held_out_facts: scooter_owner: The scooter belonged to the suspect's little sister.

turns.interrogator: Q: The Gas-N-Go was robbed. The clerk said a guy with a big black gun took all the money!
turns.suspect: A: It wasn't a big black gun! It was a green squirt gun! I painted it! (internal: I don't want them thinking I had a real gun!)

turns.interrogator: Q: A squirt gun! Wow! Did you squirt him?
turns.suspect: A: No, I didn't put water in it! Water makes the paint run! (internal: I am very smart about arts and crafts.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Good point. You stole a million dollars from the register, didn't you?!
turns.suspect: A: A million? I got forty-three dollars and some gummies! (internal: he thinks I'm rich. I wish.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Gummies! I love gummies. Were they the sour kind?
turns.suspect: A: Yes! Sour Worms! They are the best! (internal: we have so much in common.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Okay, but you still robbed the place. Did you drive away in a fast sports car?
turns.suspect: A: No, I took my little sister's pink scooter! The battery died halfway down the street! (internal: the getaway was terrible.)

turns.interrogator: Q: A pink scooter! That's so funny. Did you hide in a secret underground lair?
turns.suspect: A: No, I hid behind the dumpsters at the bowling alley! It smelled like old shoes! (internal: I am literally telling him everything.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Eww, bowling alley dumpsters. Why did you even rob the place? Are you part of a gang?
turns.suspect: A: A gang? No! I was just really hungry for candy and I forgot my wallet! (internal: I am a very simple man.)

turns.interrogator: Q: So you robbed a store because you forgot your wallet.
turns.suspect: A: Yes. It seemed like a good idea at the time. Can I eat the gummies now?

turns.interrogator: Q: No, they are evidence! I get to eat the evidence!
turns.suspect: A: Hey! That's not fair! I stole those fair and square!

turns.interrogator: Q: Too bad! I'm the cop! So you confess to the water gun robbery?
turns.suspect: A: Yes. But only if you share the worms.

turns.interrogator: Q: Deal! I like the green ones.
turns.suspect: A: I like the red ones. We have a deal.

turns.interrogator: Q: Where did you park the scooter?
turns.suspect: A: It's still by the dumpsters. Don't tell my mom.

turns.interrogator: Q: I have to tell your mom, you're going to jail.
turns.suspect: A: She is going to ground me for so long.

turns.interrogator: Q: Probably. Was the gun loaded with anything?
turns.suspect: A: I told you, no water! Just green plastic and black paint!

turns.interrogator: Q: Did you threaten the clerk?
turns.suspect: A: I just said 'give me the gummies or I'll shoot you'. But I meant with water. If I had water.

turns.interrogator: Q: That's still a robbery.
turns.suspect: A: I know. I'm sorry.

turns.interrogator: Q: The clerk was very scared.
turns.suspect: A: He shouldn't be. The paint was chipping off.

turns.interrogator: Q: Sign the paper.
turns.suspect: A: Okay. Did you bring the gummies?

turns.interrogator: Q: They are at the front desk.
turns.suspect: A: Awesome. Let's go.

turns.interrogator: Q: You're under arrest.
turns.suspect: A: Sounds good.

conclusion.outcome: Interrogator wins: The easiest case in history, completed in under ten turns.
conclusion.summary: Both the interrogator and the suspect were incredibly dumb, bonding over sour gummies. The suspect confessed to all key facts enthusiastically.
